mode: User-authorized primary self-review after inline fixes; no new agent
scope: Only the two Luna findings, their regression coverage and release packaging
findings_resolved: Automatic reference-answer disclosure in feedback, replay and history
Stale draft saves/replies after fresh retry
reviewed_invariants: Reference answers are returned only by the assistance-marking reference route, not assessment/replay/history
Old draft and request hashes migrate as generation zero without deleting saved history
SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes generation validation, assistance merge, save and retry
Retry advances its generation and clears the draft in one transaction
Old-generation saves/submissions fail with HTTP 409; assessment commit validates generation again
Idempotent replays do not create a second attempt or reveal legacy reference keys
Frontend initializes from server generation, adopts retry generation and ignores old-generation save replies
Both delayed-request and delayed-successful-response races were exercised in real Chrome
limitations: Primary self-review, not independent approval of the fixes
Trusted local Java is not an OS sandbox
